summary: Built 1922 as a fire lookout and used until 1961; a 30 m (100 ft) visitor tower from 1967 stands in a township park off Highway 35.

facts.design: Observation tower with a deck 142 m (465 ft) above Lake of Bays

access.note: Owned and operated by the Township of Algonquin Highlands; use at own risk. Fall-colours viewing needs a booking from 19 September to 25 October.

visit.trail_note: Hiking trail on the site; leashed dogs allowed on the trail but not on the tower

notes_for_editor: The brief gives no local_unit for Dorset; the story names the Township of Algonquin Highlands from the owner's page. The sources do not say whether the 1967 tower stands on the 1922 footprint; the site sign links the two as one fire tower history, so the 'replaced' event is worded cautiously. height_m is the current 30 m tower; the original was 25 m. The brief's other_names entry 'Dorcet Lookout Tower' was not checked. The 19 Sep to 25 Oct fall-colours booking window includes today's date (2026-10-20).
